chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him)
He mentioned therein the Angel of Death, and the departing of the souls, and the incapacity of creation to describe Allah

key_terms.تَوْفِيَةَ الْأَنْفُسِ: Departing of souls / Taking of souls

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the Angel of Death and humanity's ability to describe God?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) elucidates the mechanics of *Ruh* (spirit) and *Nafs* (soul) during the transition from the temporal world to the eternal realm, emphasizing the Angel of Death as the divine agent of this transition. This passage underscores the theological concept of *Tawhid* by contrasting the finite capacity of human description with the infinite, ineffable essence of Allah, a theme central to Shia metaphysical discourse on the soul's journey.
